create_async_http_handler: create an AsyncHTTPHandler with custom timeout, SSL verification, and shared aiohttp session
create_sync_http_handler: create an HTTPHandler with custom timeout, SSL verification, and optional pre-built httpx.Client
build_cached_async_client: build a cached async HTTP client via get_async_httpx_client for a given LLM provider with params
build_cached_sync_client: build a cached sync HTTP client via _get_httpx_client with configurable timeout and SSL settings
configure_ssl_context: configure SSL context via get_ssl_configuration with custom CA bundle, cipher level, and ECDH curve
